title: Common-line presentations and nonnegative powers under scalar extension
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site with finite limits and final object, small relative to the sheaf universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and sheafified tensor products and recursively associated tensor powers [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $B\to A$ be a map of commutative ring sheaves, let $C_0\to C_1$ be a map of commutative $B$-algebra sheaves, and let $T$ be an $A$-module sheaf. Put $R_i=A\otimes_B C_i$ with multiplication $(a\otimes c)(a'\otimes c')=aa'\otimes cc'$ and unit $1\otimes1$, $L_i=T\otimes_B C_i$, and let $\iota:R_0\to R_1$ be induced by $C_0\to C_1$. There are natural $R_i$-linear isomorphisms
$$i_i:T\otimes_A R_i\xrightarrow{\sim}L_i,\qquad t\otimes(a\otimes c)\longmapsto at\otimes c,$$
with inverse $t\otimes c\mapsto t\otimes(1\otimes c)$; these commute with the maps induced by $C_0\to C_1$. Set $P_i(0)=R_i$ and $P_i(n)=L_i^{\otimes_{R_i}n}$ for $n\geq1$. There are natural isomorphisms
$$b_n:P_0(n)\otimes_{R_0}R_1\xrightarrow{\sim}P_1(n)\qquad(n\geq0).$$
Here $b_0(r\otimes s)=\iota(r)s$; through $i_0,i_1$, $b_1((t\otimes r)\otimes s)=t\otimes\iota(r)s$ with inverse $t\otimes s\mapsto(t\otimes1)\otimes s$; and $b_{n+1}$ for $n\geq1$ is the canonical relative tensor comparison followed by $b_n\otimes b_1$. If $T$ is locally free of rank one, meaning $T|_U\cong A|_U$ on a covering of the final object, all $P_i(n)$ are locally free of rank one on that same covering. For a local generator $e$ of $T$, put $e_i=i_i(e\otimes1)$ and $e_i^0=1$. The maps satisfy
$$b_n((r e_0^{\otimes n})\otimes s)=\iota(r)s e_1^{\otimes n}.$$
All displayed formulas are formulas on local pure tensors in the sheafified tensor products, and commute with restrictions.
